info.title: Nextcloud Budget REST API
info.description:
Public, versioned API for reading a Budget instance and recording transactions from outside the web UI — a phone capture app, a script, or automation tooling.

Authenticate with a Nextcloud app password (personal settings > Security), or a token obtained through Nextcloud's Login flow v2. Every request must also send `OCS-APIRequest: true`; without it Nextcloud answers 412.

Every response is wrapped in an OCS envelope — the payload is at `ocs.data`, and `ocs.meta.statuscode` mirrors the HTTP status. Schemas below describe the contents of `ocs.data`.

The internal endpoints the web UI itself calls (under /apps/budget/api/..., without /ocs/) are not part of this contract and change without notice.

get.description: Call this first. Confirms the app is installed and the credentials work, and reports which optional features this instance has.
Every account the user owns plus every account shared with them. Balances are as of today; future-dated transactions are excluded.
Flat list; build the tree from parent_id. Includes categories shared with the user.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Restrict to one category type. Note categories are typed expense/income while transactions are typed debit/credit.

get.description: Most recent first, across every account the user can see.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text match on description and vendor.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Values above the maximum are clamped, not rejected.

post.description: Record a transaction. Rate limited to 60 per minute per user. The account balance is recalculated automatically. Writing into an account shared by another user records the transaction against that owner ledger. An idempotency_key (or Idempotency-Key header) makes retries safe: a repeat within 7 days answers 201 with the transaction the first attempt recorded. An optional multipart photo is attached after recording; if attaching fails the response still succeeds and carries photo_error.

photo_error.description: Present only when the transaction was recorded but the inline photo could not be attached. Never re-post in that case; retry with the same idempotency_key (which heals the photo) or attach via POST /transactions/{id}/receipts.

409.description: error_code idempotency_key_conflict: the key was already used for a DIFFERENT transaction (another account or amount) - a client bug, not a retry. error_code request_in_flight: the original request carrying this key is still executing and did not finish within the wait - retry shortly, nothing was duplicated.

get.description: From any account the user can see. The joined accountName / accountCurrency / categoryName fields are not included here.
Owner-only: receipts live in the owner's Files, so a transaction in a shared account returns 404 here even though GET /transactions/{id} can read it.

post.description: Owner-only. The file is stored in the user's own Files under Budget/Receipts/<year>/ and referenced from the transaction. Rate limited to 10 per minute per user.

file.description: JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, or PDF, up to 25 MB. The authoritative list is in GET / limits.

post.summary: Extract a draft transaction from a receipt photo
post.description: Capture-before-save: the image (multipart field image; file accepted too) is read by the configured OCR provider and a draft comes back for the user to confirm. Nothing is recorded; record the draft with POST /transactions. No side effects, so retrying is always safe. Only the image is sent to the provider; the category suggestion is computed locally from the user own rules. Rate limited to 10 per minute per user. Check ocr_available on GET /capabilities before showing this flow. A draft with no readable total is answered as 422 ocr_extraction_failed - total is the one field the contract requires.

image.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 25 MB. The authoritative list is receipt_ocr_mime_types in GET / limits. Detected from the bytes, not the declared type. The field name file is accepted as an alias.

412.description: error_code ocr_not_configured: no OCR provider is set up on this server (ocr_available is false). A 412 WITHOUT an error_code is Nextcloud reporting a missing OCS-APIRequest header.

429.description: error_code ocr_quota_exhausted: the provider meter ran out. Without the code it is this API own rate limit.

422.description: error_code ocr_extraction_failed: the provider failed, or no total was readable. Safe to retry.

post.summary: Split a transaction into per-category parts
post.description:
Replaces any existing splits. The parts must sum to the transaction amount and there must be at least two. Intended for capture apps that read a receipt and let the user categorise each item.

Owner-scoped: on a shared account the splits are written to the account owner's ledger, like the transaction and its receipts.

400.description: The parts do not sum to the transaction amount, there are fewer than two, or `splits` is not a usable array. The message states which.

404.description: No such transaction for this user

basicAuth.description: Nextcloud user ID plus an app password (personal settings > Security > Devices & sessions). Not the login password.

Unauthorised.description: Not authenticated, or the app password has been revoked.

NotFound.description: No such record, or one the user cannot see.

ReadOnly.description: The account is visible but not writable — a read-only share.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests; wait and retry.

MissingOcsHeader.description: The OCS-APIRequest: true header is missing.

error.description: Human-readable, translated into the user's language.
error.example: Date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format

detail.description: Present only for database faults, to make them diagnosable.

error_code.description: Stable machine-readable code, present on failures clients must distinguish programmatically: ocr_not_configured, ocr_quota_exhausted, ocr_extraction_failed, idempotency_key_conflict, request_in_flight. Switch on this, never on the error text.

api_version.description: Contract version. Bumped only for a breaking change.

app_version.description: Advisory only — never gate on it.

features.description: Optional capabilities of this instance. Values may flip from false to true as features land; clients must tolerate that.

receipt_ocr.description: Server-side receipt extraction (POST /ocr/extract). True only when the administrator has configured an OCR provider; can flip either way as the server configuration changes.

receipt_ocr_mime_types.description: Image types POST /ocr/extract accepts - narrower than receipt_mime_types because OCR backends read bitmaps.

type.description: checking, savings, credit_card, cash, investment, crypto, loan, other.

balance.description: Decimal string, two places. As of today; future-dated transactions are excluded. Liability accounts (credit_card, loan, mortgage, line_of_credit) carry a NEGATIVE balance for the amount owed; a positive value means the account is in credit. Parse into an exact decimal type, never a float.

balance_in_base_currency.description: Decimal string, two places. Set only when the account is not already in the user's base currency.

shared.description: True for an account another user shared. It may be read-only — handle 403 on create.

amount.description: Decimal string, two places. Always positive; type carries the direction. Parse into an exact decimal type, never a float.

type.description: debit is money out, credit is money in.

status.description: cleared, pending, or scheduled (a future-dated transaction).

is_split.description: True when the transaction is split across categories in the web UI. Splits are not exposed in v1.

category_name.description: List responses only, and absent on uncategorised rows.

splits.description: Present on a create that supplied splits and they were accepted.

splits_error.description: Present when the transaction was created but its splits were rejected. The transaction is correct and unsplit; do not retry the create.
splits_error.example: Split amounts (3.00) must equal transaction amount (23.77)

total.description: Full match count, not the page size.

NewTransaction.description: Body of POST /transactions (form-urlencoded, or multipart when a photo rides along).

account_id.description: Must be an account the user can write to.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. A future date is stored as scheduled.

merchant.description: Becomes both the description and the vendor. One of merchant/description is required.

amount.description: Always positive. Accepted as a number or a decimal string; always returned as a two-place string.

description.description: Wins over merchant for the description when both are sent.

vendor.description: Wins over merchant for the vendor when both are sent.

photo.description: Optional receipt image, attached after the transaction is recorded. Omit the part entirely when there is none. If attaching fails the response still succeeds and carries photo_error.

idempotency_key.description: A UUID per draft (not per attempt). A repeat within 7 days answers 201 with the transaction the first attempt recorded, inserting nothing. Also accepted as an Idempotency-Key header.

splits.description: Optional per-item splits, as a JSON array of NewSplit objects. A string so it can ride in the same multipart body as `photo`. The parts must sum to `amount` and there must be at least two. If they are rejected the transaction is still created and the response carries `splits_error` — retrying would duplicate the transaction, which the idempotency key exists to prevent.

file_id.description: Nextcloud file id in the owner's Files — usable with WebDAV.

missing.description: True when the underlying file has been deleted from Files; the reference survives.

ReceiptDraft.description: A draft transaction extracted from a receipt image. Every field the provider could not read is null (or an empty list) rather than a guess — the user fills those in.

total.description: Decimal string, two places. The one field a draft always has: with no readable total the endpoint answers 422 ocr_extraction_failed instead. Kept even when the line items disagree (see warnings).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code printed on the receipt, when legible. Compare with the target account's currency before saving. The Nextcloud AI provider never reports one — treat null as unknown, not as matching the account.

suggested_category_id.description: Computed locally from the user's own categorisation rules; the provider never sees the category tree.

subtotal.description: Pre-tax figure, only when the receipt prints one. Needed to reconcile line items against the total when tax is listed separately.

tax.description: The VAT/sales tax line, only when the receipt prints one. Add it to the line items to reach the total; send it as its own split.

discount.description: Total money taken off — loyalty savings, coupons, multibuy — as a POSITIVE figure, only when the receipt prints one. Subtract it from the line items to reach the total; send it as a negative split.

Capabilities.description: Minimal discovery for capture clients: three keys, exactly. GET / (Info) carries the same facts and more.

splits_available.description: Whether this server accepts per-item splits. Absent on older servers; treat absence as false.

currency.description: The base currency of the requesting user.

version.description: Installed app version; advisory, never a gate.

RecentTransaction.description: One row of GET /transactions/recent: flat and merchant-first, for a capture client to render a glanceable list.

merchant.description: The recorded vendor when there is one, else the description.

Split.description: One category allocation of a split transaction.

amount.description: Fixed-point decimal string, as everywhere else in v1.
Decimal string or number. MAY be negative for a savings or coupon line; zero is refused. The parts must sum to the transaction amount.

category_id.description: Omit or null to leave the part uncategorised (useful for a tax line).
